instruction: Configure Filebeat to ship syslog to Logstash
output:
cat > /etc/filebeat/filebeat.yml << 'EOF'
filebeat.inputs:
- type: syslog
  enabled: true
  paths:
  - /var/log/syslog
output.logstash:
  hosts: ["localhost:5044"]
EOF && systemctl start filebeat

instruction: Configure Heartbeat to monitor a URL
output:
cat > /etc/heartbeat/heartbeat.yml << 'EOF'
heartbeat.monitors:
- type: http
  urls: ["https://example.com"]
  schedule: '@every 10s'
output.elasticsearch:
  hosts: ["localhost:9200"]
EOF && systemctl restart heartbeat-elastic
